name: openchatcut
tagline_zh: 让AI直接上手你的剪辑工程，改字幕、调时间线、导出成片。不用再手动翻找素材，说句话就搞定。
tagline_en: Let AI edit your local video project directly—timeline, captions, export. No manual digging, just ask.
desc_en: Connect an MCP-capable coding agent to OpenChatCut and edit local video projects. Use when the user asks to install, connect, or set up OpenChatCut; inspect or edit an OpenChatCut project; work with its timeline, transcript, captions, media, generation, motion graphics, audio, color, or export tools; or recover from an OpenChatCut MCP error.
why_zh: 同类工具只给API，它把MCP接进OpenChatCut，让AI能读能改工程文件，真正动手剪。
why_en: Others just offer APIs; this wires MCP into OpenChatCut, letting AI read and modify real project files.
